brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: 3 bases in row with keyhole hangers on rear outer faces slots 1: accessory:0#-1,0#1, accessory:0#0,0#1, accessory:0#1,0#1
Hook plates on front faces slot 4: accessory:0#-1,0#4, accessory:0#0,0#4, accessory:0#1,0#4 - each plate has two hooks

finish.summary: Three-hex linear rack provides wall-mounted tool storage: keyhole hangers on back, 6 hooks on front across 3 cells.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
Build: 3-hex linear tool rack ( -1,0 / 0,0 / 1,0 ) hung from wall.

- Keyhole hangers on rear faces (slot 1 north side) on each cell allow wall mounting via existing screws lift-and-drop.
- Hook plates on front faces (slot 4 opposite) provide two hooks per plate x 3 cells = 6 hooks for small hand tools (pliers, wrenches, etc).

Mesh clear, no errors. Caps/ joint bolts optional but not required for functional brief.
